stories.title: Cleveland police officer pleads guilty to 2nd OVI offense, along with felony weapons charge
stories.summary: Cleveland Police Officer Sean Morris has pleaded guilty to an OVI charge and a felony weapons offense after driving drunk with a loaded gun in Willowick.

stories.title: Ohio lawmakers race to advance high-profile bills as 136th General Assembly winds down
stories.summary: Ohio lawmakers race to pass pivotal bills on education, abortion, gun rights, and labor before the legislative session ends, likely impacting state policy debates.

stories.title: Barricade situation inside Willoughby Hills home prompts heavy police response
stories.summary: The Western Lake County Emergency Response Team and the Willoughby Police Department is dealing with a barricaded male subject on Eddy Road Thursday evening.

stories.title: Cleveland 3rd grader brings loaded, stolen gun to school, sparking state lawmaker's call for action
stories.summary: A loaded gun brought to Cleveland school by third grader was reported stolen, a CMSD report reveals.

stories.title: OHSAA suspends Massillon football stars Brayton and Brydon Feister, citing investigation into alleged recruiting violations
stories.summary: The Ohio High School Athletic Association has suspended Massillon football stars Brayton and Brydon Feister amid an investigation into alleged recruiting violations.

stories.title: Ohio Secretary of State Frank LaRose wants to oversee voter rolls in new office as state auditor
stories.summary: In Ohio, Auditor-elect Frank LaRose seeks to retain some control over voting rolls, prompting criticism from Secretary of State-elect Allison Russo.

stories.title: Ohio State builds 24-point lead in first half, beats UMBC 101-62
stories.summary: Ohio State dominates UMBC 101-62, with Justin Pippen scoring 15 of his 17 points in the first half.

stories.title: Ohio anti-abortion bills sent to Gov. Mike DeWine face likely legal challenges
stories.summary: Two new bills imposing abortion restrictions await Gov. DeWine's signature, but advocates say they could conflict with the state's Reproductive Freedom Amendment.

stories.title: Gervasi unveils its Christmas Villa, a new holiday escape in Canton
stories.summary: From Candy Cane Lane to the North Pole, Gervasi's new Christmas Villa offers a holiday-themed overnight experience complete with plenty of festive touches.

stories.title: Why is Mentor Public Schools closing 3 elementary buildings? Superintendent Craig Heath explains
stories.summary: Craig Heath says Mentor Schools' consolidation plan will help the district save $3.4 million annually, with about 45 staff positions expected to be eliminated.

stories.title: 11 Ohio Medicaid providers indicted in alleged fraud schemes, including double billing and charging for dead clients
stories.summary: Ohio Attorney General Andy Wilson announced indictments for 11 Medicaid providers accused of fraud, with alleged improper billings exceeding $115,000.

stories.title: City of Cleveland names Brendan McNamara as new fire chief
stories.summary: McNamara, a Cleveland native and St. Ignatius graduate, was appointed by Mayor Justin Bibb as the city's next fire chief after nearly 30 years with the department.
